articles.title: Capcom Confirms Data Breach Exposing 11.7 Million CAPCOM ID Records
articles.summary:
Capcom has confirmed a data breach that affects 11,774,247 CAPCOM ID records worldwide. An unauthorized third party accessed customer information linked to its online membership service. This incident, disclosed on October 22, 2026, exposed email addresses and account metadata. A smaller subset of records also included personal profile information and unauthorized password changes. articles.title: Suspected Chinese APT41 Hackers Use BlackX Bootkit to Bypass Windows Secure Boot
articles.summary:

Researchers attribute the operation to APT41 with medium confidence. BlackX closely resembles BlackLotus, the bootkit advertised on underground forums for $5,000 in October 2022.
